newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA TRAVEL MULLS SALE OF STEEL PLANT.
newsitem.headline: CHINA TRAVEL MULLS SALE OF STEEL PLANT.

text.p: China Travel International Investment Hong Kong Ltd said on Friday it was in talks to sell its interest in Tangshan Guofeng Steel Co Ltd to parent China Travel Service (Holdings) Hong Kong Ltd (CTS Holdings).
"It is in discussion with CTS (Holdings) in relation to the possible disposal of its interest in Tangshan Guofeng," the company said in a statement.
"No details have been finalised in relation to the possible disposal nor has it been confirmed whether or when such possible disposal will be completed," it said.

Tangshan Guofeng, which is 51 percent owned by the company and 49 percent by the Economic Developing Corporation of Xu Ge Zhuang, operate a steel plant in Fengnan City in China's Hebei province, it said.
China Travel said it would make a further statement if the disposal entered into agreement.
